thesis: The guest argues that David Swensen played a different game from public market investors by maintaining a long time horizon, an equity orientation, and diversification across assets that look like equity rather than relying on a standard 60/40 portfolio. He emphasizes that Swensen possessed extreme discipline in sticking to his plan and was exceptionally skilled at communicating those beliefs to his board and team to ensure everyone adhered to the strategy.
